high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Fortune.com, displayed on a mobile device. The top of the screen shows the time as 3:33 PM, with a battery icon indicating the phone's power level. The website URL "fortune.com" is visible at the top center. The main content of the article discusses a technology trend called "vibe coding," which involves using natural language prompts to generate and iterate on code. The text explains that this method allows users to describe their intent without writing complex syntax, and AI produces functioning prototypes.
